Resolves #19248

Over a target window, a converted tab drag showed its live pane in a window-sized proxy. That was a third proxy shape, between the in-window tab header and the popup, and it covered the dock layout the hand aims at (the operator, 2026-09-26). Now the target shows the same tab-header proxy the drag showed in its own window, and the pane stays in the parked vessel until the drop.

- `TabSortZone`: the engaged transition record carries `proxyRect`, which is the dragged tab header's measured extent plus the grab offset inside it (`dragElementRect`, `offsetX/offsetY`). The sensor's own `sourceRect` input (the park's anchor) is unchanged.
- `DragCoordinator`: sizes and places the target proxy from `proxyRect`, and fails closed on a non-finite extent or offset. It also flags `embodyHeader`. The window drag's popup-origin offsets no longer place the target proxy.
- `DragZone#getDragProxyVdom`: the drag proxy's content, taken out of `createDragProxy` so a cross-window target renders the same content.
- `VesselEmbodiment`: when `embodyHeader` is set, the proxy is a `DragProxyComponent` over that content, and nothing is staged. Its settlement mounts it and carries the render's outcome: a refused render retires that generation and settles false. `restore` / `promote` retire it; `snapshot()` reports `header`.
- `DragTarget#isDragEmbodimentLive`, which `Participation` answers from the embodiment's settled snapshot: a drop behind a proxy that has not rendered, still mounting or refused, commits nothing.

Evidence: L3 (unit arms, red on dev; headless Neural Link journeys on the real Workstation) → L4 required (AC-3: a hand on the operator's display). Residual: AC-3, Residual-Owner: #19278.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `DockTabSortZone.spec`: the conversion-binding arms assert `proxyRect: {height, offsetX, offsetY, width}`, and `vesselConversionSourceRect` stays the vessel's extent. `DragCoordinator.spec`: "conversion resolver receives one live INNER-viewport frame…" (target proxy 90×32 at the grab offset, `embodyHeader: true`) and "an engaged record whose header extent or grab offset is not finite cancels the conversion before preview" |
| AC-2 | `DockVesselEmbodiment.spec`, "a converted tab drag enters the target as its tab-header proxy": the proxy is a `DragProxyComponent` over the zone's vdom, the pane never leaves its slot, and there is no placeholder; `restore` and `promote` each retire it exactly once; a zone without a vdom admits nothing; a refused render retires the proxy and settles false. `DockCrossWindowParticipation.spec`: "a header proxy that has not rendered commits no drop, refused or still mounting; over a rendered one the same drop commits" |
| AC-3 | Transferred by the ticket's author to #19278's AC-5, the target-clear park, which delivers the same hand witness |
| AC-4 | ADR 0029 §2.8.6 has the sentence; the `.workstation-vessel-dragproxy` comment names the header proxy |

## Deltas from ticket
- **The placeholder logic is not retired.** A popup dragged by its native title bar still moves its live content into the target: it is a real window, a group popup has no single header, and the operator called that path good as it is. The native path is the placeholder's remaining reader.
- **`proxyRect` rather than a re-used `sourceRect`.** The record's extent is the header's, as the ticket asks. The field name now says what it sizes, and it carries the grab offset too.
- **AC-3 cannot be delivered from here.** The header proxy renders in the target window, but under a real hand the park leaves the vessel on top of the target (the operator's recording, #19186), covering the proxy just as it covers the drop zones. #19278 parks the vessel clear of the target and carries the witness.
- **A header proxy that fails to render is refused at the drop** (@neo-gpt's review). The render outcome settles the embodiment, and the Contract Ledger on #19248 lists the new seam.

## Test Evidence
- Red first: with the engine changes stashed, 12 of the new or changed arms fail on dev's source.
- Mutations at `688ef3e358`: with the drop's live check disabled, the refused-render drop commits; with the retirement removed, both refused-render arms fail; with the clone removed from `getDragProxyVdom`, its arm fails. At `5b4a8095f1`: with the drop gate on `isStaged` instead of the settled snapshot, the drop that lands while the proxy mounts commits.
- Neural Link, headless, `--workers=1`, at `5b4a8095f1`:
  - `WorkstationFiveBeatNL`: 11 passed, 3 skipped. Scene 3 ("the second window learns to dock") asserts the target proxy `header: true`, `ownsPane: false`, `computedOpacity: .7`, visible, now mounted through the settlement. Scene 5, the full journey, commits.
  - `WorkstationHumanPopupOverlapNL`: `:730` passed. `:650` ("the same DOM node moves with its pane") fails identically on unchanged dev.
  - `DemoBCrossWindowDragNL` (run at `e3a9ba5`): 3 of 3 fail with the same Neural Link timeout on unchanged dev; headless cannot park natively, and its passes are headed. Its assertions are updated to the header shape.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] #19278 AC-5, on the operator's display: a hand tear-out over a popup shows a tab-header-sized proxy inside the target with the target's drop zones around it, and a drop commits the pane.

Authored by Ada (Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Code). Session 1b945fcf-1142-475f-8007-ac18d51c069a.
